title: Education, School Enrollment, And Literacy Keep Expanding
hook: School grew upward and downward while one country packed the middle.
closing: Education expanded at every level, changing how early learning starts and how far it can go.
question: Which school level changed most?

segments.say: Primary enrollment reached 780,852,608. The education ladder now starts with a much wider base.
India has 133,156,038 secondary students. One country now carries an enormous share of the middle.
Tertiary enrollment reached 43.6 percent. School now extends far beyond childhood for a much larger share.
Youth literacy reached 93.1 percent. Wider education access is translating into a near-universal basic skill.
Preprimary enrollment reached 60.9 percent. School is expanding downward as well as upward.
